Owner's page

This page runs on your computer only. It keeps nothing: close the tab and everything it held is gone.

1. Open your key

Open this page in a browser profile without extensions: an extension can read what a page shows.

Pick the file from the e-mail (owner-half-….ksgbak) and type the password from your phone — ksgpw1: and 53 letters and digits, groups of four.

or pick a picture of the QR (a screenshot or a photo):

2. Connect to the reader

The program on the agent's machine prints one line: an address and a one-time token. Paste it here.
